Mr. P.K. Maharaj, ASC  CORAM: JUSTICE V. NARASINGH
ORDER 08.10.2024 Order No.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioners are accused in connection with G.R. Case No.376 of 2024, pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C., K.S. Nagar arising out of K.S. Nagar P.S. Case No. 381 of 2024 for commission of the alleged offence under Section 294/341/323/326/307/506/34 of IPC.
3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioners relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of their application for bail U/s.483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) by the learned Addl. Dist. & Sessions Judge, Kodala by order dated 18.07.2024 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioners who are in custody since 28.05.2024 are the first offenders and since charge sheet has been filed on 24.09.2024, they may be released on bail.
6. Learned counsel for the Petitioner further submits that the injured Banti Barik-C.W.1 has in the meanwhile discharged from the hospital and leading a normal life.
Hence, it is submitted that further continuance of the Petitioner in custody is unwarranted.

7. Learned counsel for the State referring to the order of rejection and the injuries mentioned therein opposes the prayer for bail.

8. Considering the filing of the charge sheet and that the injured has recovered and the Petitioners are the first offenders as stated, this Court directs the Petitioners to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin subject to verification of criminal antecedent.
9. If it comes to the fore that the Petitioner has any criminal antecedent, this order shall not be given effect to.

10. Additionally, it is directed that Petitioners shall appear before the jurisdictional police station twice every week on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin till conclusion of trial.
Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin.
11. It is directed that the Petitioners shall not in any way try to intimidate the informant and his family.
12. It shall be open to the informant/Prosecution to seek variance of this order, in the event there is any threat perception.
13. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
14. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Ayesha Designation: Junior Stenographer
